verdict.rationale: Proximity-based device setup is a fair question for a desktop operating system, but the evidence pack never documents setting up a new Windows PC by bringing a paired phone or other personal device near it. The generic 'rapid onboarding' marketing line names no such mechanism, and Windows Hello sign-in is an adjacent authentication feature, not device-assisted setup.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can set up a new machine quickly by bringing a paired personal device near it
